name: monstera-conformance
description: Prove the Kotlin and Swift outputs of one spec behave identically, then have two independent reviewers check the result.

steps.prompt: For the generated app at {{app}}: (1) `monstera verify {{app}}`; (2) confirm both bundled monstera.spec.json copies are byte-identical and hash to the manifest's spec sha256; (3) from G2 on, run `monstera conformance {{app}}` (golden scenarios on Kotlin/JVM and Swift). Write .kiro/workflow-output/conformance/result.json and paste its summary as your final message.

branches.prompt: Using {{artifacts.result}}, read the Kotlin runtime/shell under {{app}}/android and check that the Swift side under {{app}}/ios implements the same contract (steering 08). List every behavioural divergence with file and line. Write .kiro/workflow-output/conformance/review-kotlin-first.md.

Using {{artifacts.result}}, read the Swift runtime/shell under {{app}}/ios and check that the Kotlin side under {{app}}/android implements the same contract (steering 08). List every behavioural divergence with file and line. Write .kiro/workflow-output/conformance/review-swift-first.md.

steps.prompt: Merge .kiro/workflow-output/conformance/review-kotlin-first.md and review-swift-first.md with {{artifacts.result}} into .kiro/workflow-output/conformance/report.md. Keep only divergences, each with evidence. End with CONFORMANT or DIVERGENT.
